input.query: SELECT channel, months_since_activation, n_observable, avg_margin_eur, cac_eur, SUM(avg_margin_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY months_since_activation ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_margin_eur, SUM(avg_margin_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY months_since_activation ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) - cac_eur AS net_after_cac_eur FROM agg_unit_economics WHERE lower(channel) LIKE '%social%' ORDER BY channel, months_since_activation
